summary.text: Chloe Pierce is the Working Families Party and Democratic candidate for New York State Assembly District 107 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Scott H. Bendett (Republican / Conservative Party).
She was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Chloe Pierce won the June 25, 2024 Democratic primary for Assembly District 107, defeating Kent Sopris with 54.3% of the vote.
In the November 5, 2024 general election she lost to incumbent Scott H. Bendett, 47.1% to 52.8%.
Pierce advanced to the 2026 general election after the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary was canceled.
